reason: A DSH meta-plugin that preflights the enabled tool library and injects ranked, capability-based plugin suggestions into agent runtime context without forcing tool calls or modifying other plugin definitions.

summaries.zh: 这是一个为 DSH agent 预检当前可用插件并将匹配任务的 Top-K 插件提示注入运行时上下文的编排插件。
summaries.en: A DSH orchestration plugin that preflights visible tools and injects ranked, task-relevant plugin suggestions into the agent runtime context.

capabilities: Reads the currently visible tool schemas
Matches task requests against trigger rules and capability declarations
Injects ranked plugin suggestions into the agent runtime context
